question: Do the scanned reduced-round BLAKE/BLAKE2/ChaCha ideas transfer to a message-only 3-round BLAKE3 collision?
number: Local structure run tested all 40320 x-word permutations, the tested per-word complement family, and 31 uniform rotations with zero digest-word equalities; every free x word reaches every digest word by round 2 and no neutral/linear bias was found. This kills transfer of those symmetry ideas, but not literature completeness or 256-bit differential tails.
source: our workflow: D457 BLAKE3-r3 literature-transfer audit
notes: The local literature scan is not a proof of universal publication absence. No package/stage/filing/submission; connector/rebound paths remain open.
peak_mem: not measured separately; structure run under 1 minute, single process
held_fixed: 3-round root mode, fixed IV/flags/length, 256-bit digest, local structure experiment
reopen_if: A specific published message-only full collision or a new 256-bit differential result appears
